title: feat(work-orders): implement field staff execution service, task checklist toggling, evidence capture, and supervisor signoff
author: SmartCity360 Architecture Team
problem: Municipal field crews lacked interactive task-level checklist tracking, photographic proof of work attachment, and formal supervisor sign-off verification linked directly to civic complaint resolution.
solution: Built comprehensive WorkOrderService encapsulating full field dispatch state machine (CREATED, ASSIGNED, ACCEPTED, IN_PROGRESS, BLOCKED, SUBMITTED, VERIFICATION, COMPLETED). Engineered atomic checklist toggling with automatic percentage recalculation, photographic evidence attachment (BEFORE, AFTER, RECEIPT), supervisor approval/rejection workflows, and automated synchronized resolution of underlying complaints.
security_considerations: Strict supervisor role-based approval gating, audit history logging, and staff ID validation.
